abba.note: the symmetric ABBA mean cancels a linear time trend in cost; replicate differences of the same order measure response variability

bootstrap.replicate_handling: one replicate run per order drawn uniformly per iteration
bootstrap.unit: held-out review, resampled jointly across orders

evidence.scope: differences between orders executed in one session on identical held-out reviews; response variability is included only through repeated runs of the same order
